translation: (Pushing one level further, setting forth the transformation of qi, then the principle of the first half becomes all the more complete and rounded.) If one does not understand the root and branch (標本), and takes the similar as the true, one will be wrong from beginning to end. Therefore whenever one sees the lower part feeling cold, with both knees like ice, these are all cases of the heart fire not descending, resembling cold water in appearance; one should add cold drugs to purge it three to five times, and then the fire will descend and the qi will ascend, and the cold transformation will retreat of itself. (This 'purge' means clearing and descending it, not attacking and purging. Such upper-heat and lower-cold is indeed fire not descending; but the reason the fire does not descend—is it not that there is cold to obstruct it? In treating this, the established methods are very many; one must not indiscriminately use cold purging. Moreover, upper-heat and lower-cold, and internal-heat and external-cold, are both true cold and true heat; they are still one level removed from true heat manifesting the false appearance of cold.) Nevertheless, the whole world is equally stubborn and deluded, to the point that the two books the Yi (《易》) and the Su (《素》) are cast aside like rotten soil—truly lamentable! Therefore, in composing a formula, one must understand the root and branch of the disease, reach what the drugs are capable of, and penetrate what the qi is suited to, so that there is no harm done; this is how one regulates and composes the formula.
translator_notes: 標本 rendered 'root and branch'; 素 refers to 素問 (Suwen); parenthetical commentary preserved.
